name: Goblet Duck Walk
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest, elbows tucked (goblet position).
Sink into a deep squat and stay low.
Walk forward in the deep squat with small, controlled steps — no bouncing.
Keep your chest tall and heels down for the prescribed distance.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: An intermediate dumbbell squat-pattern exercise for the quadriceps. Goblet Duck Walk develops leg strength through a full range of motion, which carries straight into daily life.
